vc_sentences: NIE029: Field Explanation now derives PeriodoNomina from the employee's pay group (Master Data 'CO - Monthly' -> 5) and records the second population paid WT 61100 'Weekly advance' outside the monthly G2N, pending client confirmation of its pay cycle.

NIE041: Field Explanation adds that the client holds no worker-type code; it is derived from a client-approved mapping of Master Data Employee Group/Subgroup (Group 6 / E2 interns paid WT 62149, Accumulated WT 64116 = 1), with the 12 vs 19 apprentice split to be supplied by the client.
NIE042: no change to the rule; Query to RA added on the meaning of Master Data 'Pensioner Effective Date' for the 2 employees carrying it (decision of 15 Oct 2026).

NIE044: Field Explanation adds the derivation of the document type from the Master Data document columns ('Citizenship Card ID' -> 13, 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' -> 22; 'Identity Card' and 'National ID' pending a client code) and the need for a precedence rule where several columns are filled.

NIE045: Field Explanation adds the client source (same Master Data document column as NIE044; G2N 'National ID' blank for 14 foreign employees) and a leading-zero check on every document column under xsd:integer.
NIE047: Field Explanation adds the client source (Master Data 'Second Last Name', blank for 144 of 261 employees in Sep-2026) and that the CO-GAP-07 placeholder decision applies to most documents.

NIE050: Field Explanation adds that the client has no work-country field; Master Data 'Country' is the home-address country and must not be used; derive from the work location or a client-confirmed default CO.

NIE051: Field Explanation adds that the client has no DIVIPOLA department of the place of work ('Employee Address - Department' is the home department in letter codes); build it from a client-approved 'Work location' -> DIVIPOLA table.

NIE052: Field Explanation adds the client source (Master Data 'Work location', free-text city names, 12 values, 2 blanks) and the translation to the 5-digit DIVIPOLA code; a blank work location blocks the document.

NIE056: Field Explanation adds that the client has no integral-salary flag; set true for salary WT 62140 'Integral Salary' (62141 arrears) and false for WT 62100 'Ordinary Salary' (Sep-2026: 88 integral, 153 ordinary, 20 interns on WT 62149).
NIE061: Field Explanation adds that Master Data 'Employment Contract Type' holds 'WM' for all 261 employees and does not carry the table 5.5.2 term; a client-supplied source is required.
NIE062: no change to the explanation; Query to RA added on the 4 integral employees whose G2N 'Salary Assigned' differs from Master Data 'Basic Salary'.
NIE065: Field Explanation adds the client source (Master Data 'Pay Method' Bank/Cash -> 42 or 45 / 10) and that bank details still held for a cash-paid employee must be suppressed.

NIE067: Field Explanation adds that Master Data 'Bank Account Type' is a code ('02' for all 258 employees with bank data) to be translated to the standardised text; the client's bank file labels these accounts 'Transferencia-Cuenta Ahorro'.

NIE002: Field Explanation adds that the client holds three start dates (Hire Date, Original Hire Date, Adjusted Service Date; differing for 40 / 21 employees) and that the client must confirm which one is FechaIngreso; Master Data dates are DD-MM-YYYY.
NIE006: Field Explanation adds that TiempoLaborado is computed from the start date confirmed for NIE002 and never from a different date.

NIE069: Field Explanation adds that no client counter gives days worked net of vacation/leave (Accumulated WT 63812 is the gross month count, 63953 the PILA day count); the value is 30 minus the Leave Absence Report days of the month unless the client names a counter.

NIE070: Field Explanation adds the client source (sum of WT 62100 'Ordinary Salary' and 62140 'Integral Salary'; vacation days paid in 79401 excluded; WT 62149 excluded) and that salary arrears 62101/62141 need a client decision.

NIE071 / NIE141 / NIE142: AuxilioTransporte is limited to employees earning up to 2 SMMLV (Ley 15 de 1959); the collective-agreement transport allowance WT 62523 paid above 2 SMMLV is reported in AuxilioS or AuxilioNS according to the salary character agreed in the convention, which is queried to the client (decision of 15 Oct 2026).

NIE108: Field Explanation adds that client WT 62845 'Night, Sunday or holiday surcharge' does not separate the night (code 7) from the day (code 5, NIE098) Sunday/holiday surcharge and must be split or confirmed by the client; hours are not held in any report.

NIE109 / NIE110: Field Explanation adds the client source (Leave Absence Report 'Date From'/'Date To' for WT 79001, DD-MM-YYYY to be converted to AAAA-MM-DD) and that previous-month dates paid in the month are reported with their actual dates.

NIE112: Field Explanation adds the client source (G2N WT 79401 per employee; per-episode Pago split by days because the Leave Absence 'Amount' is repeated on multi-episode rows) and excludes WT 62150 'Vacation Bonus'.
NIE116: Field Explanation adds the client source (WT 79403 'Vacations Compensated In cash' and, on a termination document, WT 62116 'Vacation Terminations').

NIE117: Field Explanation adds the candidate client source (Accumulated WT 63811 'Worked Days In Semester', resetting 1 Jan / 1 Jul) and that WT 42961, with the same description, is a different count the client must explain, together with which counter is net of unpaid leave.
NIE118: Field Explanation adds the client source (WT 62211 'Service Legal Bonus' only) and that the extralegal March/Christmas/August bonuses 62208-62210 are not the statutory prima.
NIE119: Field Explanation adds the candidate extralegal WTs (62208, 62209, 62210, 62204) whose salary character the client must confirm before they are reported as Primas PagoNS or Bonificacion.

NIE120: Field Explanation adds the client sources (direct payments WT 62110 and 62126; annual fund consignment only as informative WT 25827/65805 in February) and that the DIAN source must settle whether the consignment is reported here and in which month.

NIE123 / NIE124: Field Explanation adds the client source (Leave Absence Report dates for WT 79008 / 79011, DD-MM-YYYY to AAAA-MM-DD) and that employer-paid and EPS-paid days of one episode are separate rows.
NIE126: Field Explanation adds that the type is derived from the WT (79008 / 79011 -> 1 Comun); no occupational-incapacity WT exists in the client data.

NIE127: Field Explanation adds the client source (G2N WT 79408 / 79411; per-episode rows 79008 / 79011 in the Leave Absence Report) and the Sep-2026 evidence that both portions were paid at 100% of the daily salary, as client evidence for CO-GAP-03/04 pending confirmation.
NIE128 / NIE129: Field Explanation adds the client source (Leave Absence Report dates for WT 79006 'Maternity Leave Payment' and WT 79007 'Paternity Leave Payment', DD-MM-YYYY to AAAA-MM-DD).
NIE132 / NIE133: Field Explanation adds the client source (Leave Absence Report dates for WT 79018 'Paid Leave', 79014 'Bereavement Leave' and 79019 'Jury/ Elector Leave', DD-MM-YYYY to AAAA-MM-DD).

NIE146: Field Explanation adds the candidate client WTs with no dedicated element (65821, 1910, 62203) and that the client WT description is used as DescripcionConcepto after client confirmation and S/NS classification.

NIE153 / NIE154: Field Explanation adds the client source (non-cash WT 65818 'Meal Allowance Inf.' with its equal offset WT 21115) and states that S vs NS follows the agreed salary character of WT 65818 (CST arts. 127-128), the 41 UVT / 310 UVT test of ET art. 387-1 being tracked separately for the withholding base and Format 2276.

NIE193 / NIE195: Field Explanation adds the client's informative third-party benefit WTs ('Inf.' earnings in the Non Cash grouping) and their equal offsetting deductions, excluding employer costs and bases in the same grouping and the loan WT 67090.

NIE194: Field Explanation adds the client's advance WTs (61100 'Weekly advance', 62838 'Exceptional Advance', paid in runs other than the monthly G2N) and that every run of the month is included; the recovery via WT 21215 is subject to client confirmation.

NIE157: Field Explanation adds the client source (WT 62149 'Internship Pay - Sustainability Support- INKOMPASS', 20 employees, Group 6 / E2, Accumulated WT 64116 = 1) and that the bidirectional check with NIE061 / NIE041 cannot be met from the client data held today.
NIE160: Field Explanation adds the client source (WT 62180 / 62181 'Severance/Layoff Payment') and warns that 'Severance' here is the dismissal indemnity, not cesantias (NIE120).
NIE164: no change to the 0.00 rule for an employed old-age pensioner; Query to RA added on the 2 employees with Master Data 'Pensioner Effective Date' (decision of 15 Oct 2026).

NIE167-NIE170: Field Explanation adds that the client computes one wage type 2553 'Solidarity Pension Fund' holding the total FSP, which the engine splits into the solidarity (0.50%) and subsistence amounts per Ley 797 de 2003 art. 8; 7 employees exceed 2% of WT 64990 in Sep-2026, so the add-back check needs a base check or tolerance.

NIE177: Field Explanation adds the client source (WT 2552 'Income Tax (employee)'; WT 21330 'Theoretical' for 6 employees pending confirmation; other withholding WTs 21129 / 25832 / 25833 to confirm; 25834 excluded) and the reconciliation to Form 350 and to the Base of Withholding; the contingent withholding is queried, not mapped.

NIE198: Field Explanation adds the client source (sum of the FVOL WTs 25811-25815 / 25823, equal to Base of Withholding 'Contribution APV') and that the client WTs do not separate RAIS voluntary contributions from voluntary pension funds; 21210/21211 'Plan Institucional PROTECCION' to be classified.

NIE171 / NIE172: Field Explanation adds that the client stores union amounts only (WTs 21550 CUT, 21680 national, one sectional 21552 / 21560 / 21562 / 21670; exactly 3 per unionised employee, 74 employees) so the rate must be configured per union WT, and that one Sindicato per union WT is emitted if the XSD allows repetition.

NIE196: Field Explanation adds the candidate client WT 21215 'Legalization Salary Payment', which the client must qualify per line (advance recovery, off-cycle payment or loan refinancing) before it is mapped here, and keeps it separate from employer-loan repayments (NIE185); the shared WTC code CO-DED-PRESTAMO must be split.

NIE197: Field Explanation adds the candidate client deductions with no dedicated element (21127, 25817, 21615, 21821, expatriate 1204 / 21126), each to be confirmed by the client as OtraDeduccion, NIE195 or excluded.

NIE180: Field Explanation adds the candidate client WTs (Foncoltabaco 21192 / 21193 / 21123 / 21116 / 21117 / 21122 / 21124 and cooperative 21617), summed into one amount, pending client confirmation that employee-fund deductions are reported here.

NIE185: Field Explanation adds the client source (employer-loan repayments 27010 / 27011 / 27040) and that loan disbursements paid through payroll (WT 67010 entitlement; non-cash WT 67090) need a decision on the accrued element that carries them.

NIE187 / NIE188: Field Explanation adds how the client's G2N groupings (Entitlements, Deductions, Non Cash) feed the totals, that deductions are stored as negative amounts, that employer costs and bases in the Non Cash grouping are never totalled, and that negative Entitlement lines need a rule before build.

NIE189: Field Explanation adds the reconciliation rule - ComprobanteTotal equals the cash net paid (Entitlements + Deductions + any non-cash item funding a cash deduction, WT 67090), which ties to the client's Bank Payments 'Net Pay' for 255 of 255 employees in Sep-2026; the carry-forward WTs 1910 / 1204 remain a client decision.
21 section-header and separator cells stored as formulas (rendered as #NAME? in Excel) converted to plain text in: Nomina Electronica Spec, Sample File. No content change.
